chernarus.name: Chernarus
chernarus.tagline: The original. Green hills, a long industrial coast and the most familiar ground in DayZ.
facts: South Zagoria province, Republic of Chernarus
The area around Povrly, Czech Republic
chernarus.intro: Chernarus is the first official DayZ map and an updated version of the Chernarus terrain from the original DayZ mod. It covers the north-eastern province of the fictional Republic of Chernarus: rolling forested hills, deep valleys and lush meadows inland, with sprawling industrial cities, highways and railways along the Green Sea coast.
history: Chernarus was created by Bohemia Interactive as the setting of Arma 2 (2009). In 2012 the DayZ mod for Arma 2 turned it into a zombie-survival sandbox, and its success led to the standalone DayZ: early access in December 2013 and the full 1.0 release on PC on 13 December 2018, on the reworked terrain known internally as "ChernarusPlus".
Its landscape is modelled on the Czech Republic, Bohemia Interactive's home country. Elektrozavodsk is based on Povrly, Solnechny on Dobkovice and Berezino on Malšovice.

In the lore, the Republic of Chernarus is a post-Soviet state on the Green Sea near the Caucasus. Slavic peoples settled the area around the 11th century, the country was united in the 13th century, joined the Russian Empire in 1631 and regained independence when the USSR dissolved in 1991. The capital, Novigrad, lies outside the playable area.
features: Five major coastal towns (Chernogorsk, Elektrozavodsk, Solnechny, Berezino and Svetloyarsk) are linked by highways and rail. They are the classic fresh-spawn route.
Dense forests and ridges hide quiet villages joined by dirt tracks. Good cover, food and water for anyone who heads inland.
Several historic castle ruins and man-made landmarks are scattered across the hills.
Bases such as the Tisy military installation in the north hold the highest-tier loot, and the most danger.
The coast and offshore islands make Chernarus the map with the most rubber boats (up to 17).
chernarus.wildlife: Former farm animals and wild species: deer, wild boar, wolves and more.
chernarus.title: Chernarus

livonia.name: Livonia
livonia.tagline: A rain-soaked valley of forests, lakes and an old military training ground. Fewer resources, more bears.
facts: Polish countryside: Polish-speaking signs and towns
Late summer with heavy rain and thunderstorms
livonia.intro: Livonia, also called the Biela Valley, is DayZ's second official map: 163 km² of mixed forests, rolling hills, farmland, winding rivers, lakes and murky swamps in the south of the fictional country of Livonia. Resources are scarcer than on Chernarus, so foraging, hunting and fishing matter more.
history: Livonia was DayZ's first paid DLC, released on 3 December 2019 alongside update 1.06. With update 1.25 on 27 May 2024 it was merged into the base game, so every DayZ owner can now play it. Internally the terrain is called "Enoch".

In the lore, Livonia is a Polish-speaking country in the Baltic region, bordering Russia's Kaliningrad Oblast, Lithuania, Belarus and Poland. Standing stones suggest the land was inhabited long before Chernarus, and Branzów Castle dates from the early medieval period.
South of the Biela River lies a large pre-outbreak military training zone. Signs there are in both Polish and English, hinting at foreign forces training in the region before the infection spread.
features: The Biela River cuts the map from west to east. Lakes Jantar, Grabinskie, Sitnickie and Wolisko provide water and fishing.
South of the river is a dense belt of bases, watchtowers and barracks: Swarog, Radunin, Gieraltów, Nadbór and Lukow Airfield.
The industrial district of Nadbór, deep in the militarised south.
A sealed military bunker with keycard access, storage rooms and PO-X missiles.
Livonia's wildlife is abundant and dangerous: deer, wolves and brown bears roam the dense forests.
Frequent heavy rain and intense thunderstorms make staying dry and warm a constant job.
livonia.wildlife: Deer, wolves and brown bears; edible mushrooms and many fishing ponds.
livonia.title: Livonia

sakhal.name: Sakhal
sakhal.tagline: A frozen volcanic archipelago at the edge of the world. Cold kills here faster than bullets.
facts: ~83 km² island · ~105 km² with ice sheets
Volcanic archipelago in Russia's far east
Late winter: snow, ice and extreme cold
sakhal.intro: Sakhal is a remote, snow-covered volcanic archipelago in Russia's far east and DayZ's smallest official map. Warm clothing and a way to thaw frozen food are mandatory, but being an archipelago, it has plenty of places to fish.
history: DayZ Frostline, the game's first expansion, was announced on 9 May 2024 and released on 15 October 2024. Content creators got early access from 1 October.
To use development resources efficiently, Sakhal's terrain data is based on Tanoa from Arma 3, reshaped into a frozen island chain inspired by the Kamchatka Peninsula.
In the lore, survivors arrive on refugee ships from the mainland and wake on Sakhal's black-sand beaches, not knowing whether the archipelago has already been overrun.
features: Snow depth varies with elevation. Fires are needed far more often and warm clothing is essential.
Food is often found frozen and must be thawed by a fire before eating.
Eating contaminated snow or drinking unchelated water causes this Sakhal-only illness. Use Chelating Tablets or water springs.
Volcanic terrain, hot springs, frozen lakes and ice shelves, plus over 400 unique buildings and points of interest.
Inland lakes freeze, but the coast is rich: steelhead trout, shrimp and pollock. Reindeer roam the island.
sakhal.wildlife: Reindeer, hares and foxes on land; steelhead trout, shrimp and pollock in the sea.
gallery: The volcano over a frozen harbour
sakhal.title: Sakhal

nasdara.name: Nasdara
nasdara.tagline: The largest map yet: a scorched Takistani province of sand, oil and broken cities.
nasdara.mapCaption: Takistan national map (Nasdara is the western province). The wiki has not published a terrain map yet.
facts: Original terrain, not based on any earlier Bohemia map
Arid spring desert: extreme heat and sandstorms
nasdara.intro: Nasdara is a landlocked province of Takistan, west of Chernarus. Sand creeps in from the eastern desert, jagged mountains mark the western border, and in between lie dense Middle-Eastern cities, abandoned Soviet-era bases, historical sites, oil fields and refineries scarred by old proxy wars. Water is the most precious resource.
history: DayZ Badlands was announced on 27 June 2025 as the game's second expansion and released on 15 October 2026 together with update 1.30. Unlike Chernarus, Livonia and Sakhal, Nasdara is not ported from or based on any earlier Bohemia Interactive terrain.

Takistan first appeared in Arma 2: Operation Arrowhead (2010). In the lore, the Takistani kingdom was founded in 636, overrun by the Mongols in 1219, became a feudatory of the Russian Empire in 1892 and lost its monarchy in a 1988 coup. A war between Soviet-backed socialists and US-backed royalists followed, fuelled by the country's oil and ore, and the socialists won in 1992.
In Badlands, survivors were left behind with no one coming to pick them up, in a land that seems to have finally had enough of people.
features: Extreme heat drains water fast. Heat Stroke is a new condition: wet your clothes, wash your head and stay in the shade.
Rare sandstorms cause Silicosis (no cure, shelter and recover) and Irritated Eyes (wash your face at a water source). Wear a face covering and goggles.
Broken mud and stone buildings and wells can be rebuilt to regain their use. Badlands also added building materials such as Mortar Mix and Palm Bark.
Oil drills, refineries and abandoned Soviet-era military bases are spread across the province.
Radios can play back Morse code, and Morse code leaflets turn up as loot.
The Jana 50 moped and Bitrak 682 enduro arrived with Badlands. Nasdara has the most of them (up to 30).
Dobermanns and German shepherds, desert monitors, mouflon, plus round goby and catfish in the water.
nasdara.wildlife: Dobermann and German shepherd dogs, desert monitor, mouflon; round goby and catfish.
gallery: SCR 16 in the Badlands release trailer
Luger and officer beret (Badlands dev blog)
nasdara.title: Nasdara
